senses.gloss: m. (v. עַתִּיק) old (wine); שתי ע׳ drank old wine, i.e. has clear eye-sight.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 2:7:6">Y. Nidd. II, end, 50ᵇ</cite> <he>ר״ה שתי ע׳</he> R. Ḥ. is an expert in examining colors; <he>ר״י לא שתי ע׳</he> is R. J. no expert? <he>ר״ה שתי ע׳ דע׳</he> R. Ḥ. is a great expert.
